To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the institutional framework in place for collective action and the social capital of the WUAs in Spain, in particular the Mancha aquifer, are key to understanding the problem of groundwater overexploitation.
collective water management is an effective and sustainable solution to water scarcity in Spain, but that it needs to be accompanied by a strong institutional framework.
collective action can play a key role in groundwater management and that WUAs can be an effective tool for this.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of WUAs in groundwater management.
the role that institutions play in the management and governance of water as a common pool resource, and the role that collective action can play in this process.
how collective action and institutional design can facilitate the transition from common pool resource to common pool resource management.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
WUAs can be a powerful instrument to achieve MBCA, but they need to be supported by a strong institutional framework and the support of social capital, trust, and the right incentives.
the institutional design of WUAs and their relationship with other actors in the water governance framework, like Water Authorities, are key factors in facilitating the emergence of MBCA.
WUAs are an essential part of the institutional design of groundwater management.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
WUAs have a long tradition of self-governance in Spain.
the role that Water User Associations play in Spain is a very important and successful model for water management.
the institutional design of WUAs and social capital between WUAs are key factors in facilitating MBCA.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the design of WUAs can be a powerful tool in the fight to preserve groundwater aquifers and to ensure their sustainable use.
the institutional design of WUAs can play an important role in facilitating collective action and in promoting the development of social capital between WUA members.
collective action can be encouraged and sustained by the institutional design of WUAs, but only if these are well designed.
